about: Targets DecisionAgent (decision_gate@v1 + decision_agent@v1) must reach on decision_golden.json: extraction F1 over emitted candidates (silent and surfaced) and the Brier score of their confidence against matched/unmatched. Measured from the current defaults on their first live run; a new prompt must at least match F1 and not exceed the Brier ceiling (the measured score plus 0.02 headroom for run-to-run variance).
